Top 10 Things I Love About The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection

September 7, 2026 0
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:43
Instaread

Is The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection worth considering for a luxury voyage? After sailing aboard Luminara in Alaska, what stood out to me most was the combination of residential-style design, spacious terrace suites, thoughtful dining, personalized service and destination-focused travel in a relaxed setting. I have experienced Luminara, the newest of the three yachts, so this top 10 list reflects that voyage rather than a direct comparison with The Ritz-Carlton-Yacht Collection’s other two yachts, Evrima and Ilma. What appealed to me was not excess for its own sake, but the sense of space, privacy, service and ease throughout the journey. Read my detailed review of Luminara here.

Have you sailed with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection? If so, I would love to hear about your experience in the comments.

Disclosure: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection provided this voyage on a complimentary basis. All opinions and observations are my own.

10. Three Yachts to Choose From

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection fleet currently includes Evrima, Ilma and Luminara. I have only sailed on Luminara, so I would not present this as a firsthand comparison between the three. What I do like is the flexibility this creates for a repeat traveler. Different yacht layouts, suite configurations, sailing dates, and itineraries mean it is possible to return to the collection without simply repeating the same trip. For someone choosing among the three, the better question may be which yacht and itinerary best match the type of journey they want.

9. Destination-Focused Itineraries

The itineraries are another major reason the collection appeals to me. Voyages span regions including the Mediterranean, Caribbean, Northern Europe, Asia-Pacific and Alaska. Alaska was particularly compelling aboard Luminara because the landscape remains central to the experience. Fjords, remote coastal communities and wildlife are visible not only during excursions but also while sailing between ports. I like the relationship between the yacht and the destination: the yacht provides a comfortable base, while the destination itself remains the reason for the journey.

8. A Familiar Hospitality Standard in a Different Setting

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is distinct from The Ritz-Carlton hotel operation, but the experience draws on a recognizable philosophy of personalized, attentive hospitality. For travelers who already know The Ritz-Carlton hotels, that familiarity can provide a useful reference point. The difference is that the setting changes every day: you can wake in a new destination, explore ashore and return to the same suite in the evening. For me, the name creates an expectation, but it is the actual service, accommodation and attention to detail aboard that determine whether the experience lives up to it.

7. Marriott Bonvoy Benefits

For travelers already participating in Marriott Bonvoy, the relationship with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection can add another layer of value. Members may earn points and Elite Night Credits on qualifying voyages and use points toward eligible cruise fares, subject to current program terms and availability. Selected elite benefits may also apply depending on status. I would not choose the voyage solely because of Mariott Bonvoy, but for frequent Marriott travelers it can make the yacht experience feel connected to a broader travel ecosystem.

6. Inclusions in The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Fare

One aspect I appreciated was the simplicity of having much of the core onboard experience included in the fare. Based on my voyage, this included the suite, many onboard dining options, beverages, Wi-Fi, entertainment and onboard gratuities, with exceptions such as shore excursions, spa treatments, the signature fine-dining restaurant and certain other personal expenses. For me, the benefit was less about calling the experience ‘all-inclusive’ and more about not having to think about an additional charge every time I ordered a meal or drink.

5. A Distinctly Yacht-Like Experience

The first thing I noticed about Luminara was the scale and atmosphere. Rather than emphasizing large central entertainment spaces, the yacht prioritizes residential-style areas, natural light, open decks, and a strong connection to the water. Luminara accommodates up to 452 guests in 226 suites, contributing to a more intimate atmosphere than on much larger cruise vessels. I rarely felt as though I was moving through a crowded public space, and it was easy to find a quiet place overlooking the ocean. For me, the appeal is not having more of everything. It is having enough space, privacy and freedom for the journey to feel personal.

4. Sophisticated, Residential Design

Luminara’s interiors feel contemporary, elegant and light-filled. Warm woods, marble, soft neutral tones and carefully considered lighting create a refined atmosphere without becoming overly formal. Large windows keep the destination visible, while open decks and outdoor lounges make the relationship with the water integral to the design. The public spaces are distributed throughout the yacht, so moving from coffee to cocktails, dining, or a quiet corner feels more like exploring a hotel than navigating a single oversized central hub.

3. Spacious Suites with Private Terraces

Every suite aboard Luminara includes a private ocean-view terrace, which became one of my favorite features of the voyage. I stayed in a Grand Suite, where the combination of living space, floor-to-ceiling windows, generous storage, and residential styling made the room feel like somewhere I genuinely wanted to spend time, not simply a place to sleep between excursions. The Suite Ambassador concept added another layer of personalization. Preferences could be remembered during the voyage, and the suite became a private retreat at the end of each day.

2. Dining Aboard Luminara

Dining was one of the strongest parts of my voyage. Across the yacht, the experience felt varied enough to remain interesting throughout the week, with options ranging from Mediterranean-inspired dining and contemporary Asian cuisine to more relaxed poolside venues. What I appreciated most was that meals did not feel mass-produced. Presentation, ingredients, and service were consistently thoughtful, and dining became part of the journey rather than something fitted between destinations. Seta su Luminara is the yacht’s signature fine-dining restaurant and carries an additional charge.

1. Warm, Personal Service

If I had to choose one reason the experience stood out, it would be the service. On Luminara, I found the approach warm, polished, and personal without feeling overly formal. The smaller guest count seemed to make it easier for the team to remember preferences and create a sense of continuity throughout the voyage. The Suite Ambassador system was especially noticeable for creating a consistent point of contact. For me, this is where the connection to The Ritz-Carlton hospitality tradition felt most tangible.

Frequently Askes Questions

Who I Think This Experience Is Best For

Based on my experience aboard Luminara, I think The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection is especially appealing to travelers who value design, service, food, space, and destination discovery but prefer a more intimate atmosphere than that of a large ship.

Is Luminara a cruise ship or a yacht?

Luminara is part of The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection and is designed around a yacht-like travel experience, with residential-style spaces, private-terrace suites and a relatively intimate guest count.

How many guests does Luminara carry?

Luminara accommodates up to 452 guests in 226 suites.

Do all Luminara suites have private terraces?

All 226 suites feature private ocean-view terraces.

What is included in a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection fare?

Onboard dining options, beverages, Wi-Fi, entertainment, and gratuities are included, while shore excursions, spa treatments, and certain specialty experiences are charged separately.

Can Marriott Bonvoy members earn or use points on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection voyages?

Yes, guests can earn and use points to book a voyage with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection. I would just make sure to check their website to confirm whether the terms have changed.
